assertions.assertion: A class extending DefaultRefreshTokenService is defined
assertions.rationale: ResilientRefreshTokenService : DefaultRefreshTokenService is defined with the base constructor wired up.

assertions.assertion: The AcceptConsumedTokenAsync method is overridden to allow consumed tokens within a 30-second grace window using ConsumedTime
assertions.rationale: AcceptConsumedTokenAsync is overridden and returns true when now minus refreshToken.ConsumedTime is under 30 seconds.

assertions.assertion: The service is registered as IRefreshTokenService in the DI container
The mobile_app client has RefreshTokenUsage set to TokenUsage.OneTimeOnly
assertions.rationale: The mobile_app client sets RefreshTokenUsage = TokenUsage.OneTimeOnly.

assertions.assertion: DeleteOneTimeOnlyRefreshTokensOnUse is set to false in the persistent grant options or operational store options
assertions.rationale: options.PersistentGrants.DeleteOneTimeOnlyRefreshTokensOnUse = false is set so consumed tokens are marked, not deleted.
